cases.name: three-queued-then-one-ready
cases.detail: Blocked before any task could be assigned. `ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at10-alpha ATM_TEAM=fx-at10 atm doctor --json` -> exit 4: "HTTP client could not connect to the configured daemon endpoint\n  Recovery: Ensure atm-daemon binary is installed, then restore the single local daemon to a healthy serving state and retry." `atm list --json` under the same identity returns the identical error/exit code. Team `fx-at10` and members alpha/beta/gamma had to be created first via `atm teams add-member` (roster commands succeeded, mailbox/daemon commands did not), confirming the daemon's HTTP mailbox service itself is unreachable rather than a roster problem.

cases.name: close-releases-next
cases.detail: Not attempted: case 1 never produced a task-id to close/verify against, because task assignment requires the same unreachable daemon endpoint reported in step 1.

cases.name: reassign-notifies-both
cases.detail: Not attempted: `atm task assign`/`atm task move` need the daemon connection that failed in step 1; no queued task exists to reassign.

cases.name: move-head-readies-once
cases.detail: Not attempted: requires two assigned tasks from a working `atm task assign`, unavailable while the daemon endpoint is unreachable.

cases.name: cancel-notifies-assignee
cases.detail: Not attempted: requires a queued task from `atm task assign`, unavailable while the daemon endpoint is unreachable.

cases.name: busy-assigner-sees-terminal-lines
cases.detail: Not attempted: requires `atm task assign` + `atm task start` + `atm task list --json`, all of which return exit 4 "HTTP client could not connect to the configured daemon endpoint" against this daemon.

cases.name: cleanup
cases.detail: No tasks were ever created (all `atm task assign` prerequisites were unreachable), so there is nothing for `atm task close` to close. `atm task list --json` (identity fx-at10-alpha, team fx-at10) still returns exit 4 "HTTP client could not connect to the configured daemon endpoint" at end of run.
